title: Section 1
context: A student is phoning a letting agency to ask about renting a flat.

audio.t: You will hear a student phoning a letting agency to ask about renting a flat.
Good morning, Brightside Lettings, Hannah speaking. How can I help you?
Hello, I saw an advert online for a two-bedroom flat near the university, and I'd like some more information.
Of course. Can I take your name first?
Yes, it's Daniel Okafor. That's O-K-A-F-O-R.
Thank you, Mr Okafor. And the flat you mean is the one on Lindon Street, is that right?
I think so, yes. Number 17, Lindon Street.
Ah, it's actually Linden, with an E. That's L-I-N-D-E-N, Linden Street.
Oh, I see, thanks for correcting me. The advert said the rent was 850 pounds a month.
That was the old price, I'm afraid. The owner reduced it last week, so it's now 780 pounds a month for the whole flat.
That's better than I expected. And do you ask for a deposit?
Yes, we ask for five weeks' rent, which is the legal maximum.
Is that normal? I thought it was usually four weeks.
Some agents ask for four, but for this flat it's five.
OK. How far is it from the station? Is it near Marlow Station?
No, Marlow is a couple of stops further on. Bridgeford Station is the nearest, about ten minutes' walk.
Great, that's very convenient. Could I come and see the flat this week?
Certainly. How about Thursday at half past three?
Hmm, I've got a lecture until four on Thursdays. Could we do it a little later?
Yes, no problem. Would half past four suit you?
Four-thirty would be perfect.
Just one more question about the rent. What exactly does it cover?
Water and heating are included, and the owner has just added free internet as well, so you won't need to set that up.
Brilliant. And I suppose I'd pay for electricity myself?
That's right, electricity isn't included.
Who will I meet at the viewing?
The owner will show you round himself. His name is Mr Halloran, that's H-A-L-L-O-R-A-N.
H-A-L-L-O-R-A-N. Thank you. What if I need to change the time?
You can ring him directly on 07715 348 291.
Let me check that: 07715 348 291.
Yes, that's correct. Oh, and please bring your passport and a reference from your previous landlord.
Do I need to show proof of my income as well?
Not at this stage. The passport and the reference are enough for the viewing.
Perfect, thank you very much for your help. See you on Thursday.

blocks.instructions: Complete the form below. Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

questions.explain: Người gọi tự đánh vần: "That's O-K-A-F-O-R" nên họ là Okafor.
Người gọi nói nhầm "Lindon Street" nhưng nhân viên sửa: "it's actually Linden, with an E. That's L-I-N-D-E-N".
850 là giá cũ trong quảng cáo; nhân viên nói "it's now 780 pounds a month for the whole flat".
Người gọi tưởng là 4 tuần, nhưng nhân viên nói: "for this flat it's five".
Marlow là bẫy (xa hơn vài trạm). Nhân viên nói: "Bridgeford Station is the nearest, about ten minutes' walk".
3h30 bị loại vì người gọi có tiết đến 4 giờ; sau đó đổi sang "half past four" và người gọi xác nhận "Four-thirty would be perfect".

questions.q: Included in rent: water, heating and ______
questions.explain: "Water and heating are included, and the owner has just added free internet as well". Điện thì không bao gồm.
Nhân viên đánh vần tên chủ nhà: "Mr Halloran, that's H-A-L-L-O-R-A-N".
"You can ring him directly on 07715 348 291" và người gọi đọc lại để xác nhận.

questions.q: Bring to viewing: passport and a ______ from previous landlord
questions.explain: "please bring your passport and a reference from your previous landlord". Bằng chứng thu nhập không cần ở giai đoạn này.
